abstract: We establish unconditional theorems on multi-probe Selberg-Mobius approximation in the Nyman-Beurling Hilbert space and supercritical truncated divisor sums. First (Theorem 1), for the codimension-2 neutral subspace $W_K$ of [1], we prove that the periodic quadratic wave $b_m(k)$ satisfies the exact forward-difference identity $b_m(k+1)-b_m(k)=-f_m(k)$ at every integer $k\ge 1$, admits an exact $m$-periodic cubic antiderivative $s_m(k)$, and has closed-form GCD correlation $R_{m,n}$ vanishing whenever $\gcd(m,n)=1$. Using Weighted Schur's Test on the divisor-jump matrix and an ungrouped $(j,n)$ Zeta-$(3/2)$ Montgomery-Vaughan Hilbert inequality on the Farey set $\mathcal{F}_K$, we eliminate the Ramanujan divisor factor $(\log N)^{3/2}$ completely and prove $\|P_{W_K}((\log N)(1-g_N)-q)\|_{\mathcal{H}}\le C_{\mathrm{MS}}(C_1+C_2 K/N^{1/2})K^2(\log K)^{3/2}/N$ ($C_1=4\log 2\,\zeta(3/2)+12(\log 2)^2\approx 13.0085$), extending unconditional subspace-norm neutral descent up to $K=o(N^{1/2}(\log K)^{-3/4})$. Furthermore (Theorem 1(d) and Proposition 1(c)-(e)), we prove the exact Loewner domination $R_K\preceq (\pi^2/96)^2\operatorname{diag}(m^2)$, show that the Sobolev-regularized neutral approximant $u_{\lambda_K}\in W_K$ ($\lambda_K\to 0^+$) eliminates the $m=K$ Lagrange-multiplier boundary layer across $K\le N^{1-\varepsilon}$, and establish the exact dilation law $b_m(g\ell)\equiv g b_{m/g}(\ell)+(g^2-1)/(12m)$, the second-order Gram expansion $G(n,m)\equiv (a_m\log n-T_m(1))/n + B_m(n)/n^2 + R_m^{(3)}(n)$, the Universal Step-Space Identity $1-g_\xi(j)\equiv j S_1(\xi)-\Psi_\xi(j)$, the exact finite-$N$ Baez-Duarte constant extraction identity isolating $2+\gamma-\log(4\pi)$, the closed-form step and Franel-Kluyver tail minima $\min_{\xi\in\mathbb{R}^{N-1}}\mathcal{Q}_{\le N}(\xi)\equiv M_1(N)^2/D_N = (\pi^2/15+o(1))M_1(N)^2$ and $\min_{\xi}\mathcal{Q}_{>N}^{\mathrm{FK}}(\xi)$, the Harmonic-Shift Telescoping Identity $\mathcal{Q}_{\le X}(\xi)\equiv \sum_{q=1}^X L_q(\xi)^2 - S_X(\xi)^2/(X+1)$, the Mobius-dual basis $\tau_k$ radical-scaling law $\|\tau_k\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2\equiv (k/\operatorname{rad}(k))\|\tau_{\operatorname{rad}(k)}\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2$, and the prime-power step obstruction $\min_{g\in V_N^{\mathrm{pp}}}\|1-g\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2\ge 1/92$. Second (Theorem 2), extending de la Breteche, Dress, and Tenenbaum [2] and Graham [3], we establish the unequal-cutoff covariance profile $\mathcal{D}_2(N/X_1,N/X_2)$ and the Goldston-Yildirim mean-square error profile $\mathcal{L}_2(N/X_1)$ for $N^{1/2}<X_1\le X_2\le N$. This is an unconditional improvement for neutral observations of a prescribed approximant, not a bound on the leading residual norm of $1-g_N$ or a proof of RH.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Version 3 adds three substantial analytical extensions verified in explore_ungrouped_bernoulli2_gram_expansion.py, explore_variational_step_tail_tradeoff.py, and explore_euler_shell_schur_coercivity.py: (1) In Theorem 1(c)-(d), we replace the grouped divisor-convolution k=jn tail bound by an ungrouped (j,n) Zeta-(3/2) dyadic Cauchy-Schwarz and Montgomery-Vaughan bound over n in (M, 2M] for each fixed j >= 1. Because |mu(n)| <= 1 and sum_{j>=1} j^{-3/2} = zeta(3/2) < infinity, this completely eliminates the Ramanujan divisor factor (log N)^{3/2} from Theorem 1(c)-(d), sharpening the individual neutral discrepancy bound to |<(log N)(1-g_N)-q, u>_H| <= (C_1/N + C_2 K/N^{3/2})(c^T R_K c)^{1/2} with absolute constant C_1 = 4 log(2) zeta(3/2) + 12 (log 2)^2 approx 13.0085 and extending subspace-norm neutral descent to K = o(N^{1/2}(log K)^{-3/4}). (2) In Proposition 1(c)-(d), we prove the exact dilation law b_m(g*l) = g*b_{m/g}(l) + (g^2-1)/(12m) (g | m), the second-order Bernoulli-2 Gram expansion G(n,m) = (a_m log n - T_m(1))/n + B_m(n)/n^2 + R_m^{(3)}(n) with |R_m^{(3)}(n)| <= zeta(3)(4m^2+m)/(12n^3), the Truncated Chebyshev Step Identity 1 - g_N(j) = -(psi_N(j) - j)/log N + j E_1(N) (where psi_N(j) = psi(j) is the exact Chebyshev function on 1 <= j <= N), and the Exact Finite-N Baez-Duarte Constant Extraction Identity (log N)||1-g_N||_H^2 = (2+gamma-log(4*pi)) + <q, 1-g_N>_H + ((log N)<1, 1-g_N>_H - 2*gamma) - <(log N)(1-g_N)-q, g_N>_H. (3) In Proposition 1(e), we prove the Universal Step-Space Identity 1 - g_xi(j) = j S_1(xi) - Psi_xi(j), the Unified Integer-Coefficient Step-Propagation Formula for all j >= 1, the closed-form step and Franel-Kluyver tail minima min Q_{<=N}(xi) = M_1(N)^2 / D_N (with D_N = M_1(N)^2 + sum_{q=1}^N b_{N,q}^2 -> 15/pi^2) and min Q_{>N}^{FK}(xi), the Harmonic-Shift Telescoping Identity Q_{<=X}(xi) = sum_{q=1}^X L_q(xi)^2 - S_X(xi)^2/(X+1) and prefix duality min_{xi in S} Q_{<=R}(xi) = eta_{S,R}/(1+eta_{S,R}), and the Mobius-dual basis tau_k Ramanujan harmonic-tail isometry, Rank-2 Logarithmic Part LogPart<tau_k, tau_l>_H = (phi(l)Lambda(k) + phi(k)Lambda(l))/2, Universal GCD Radical-Dilation Law <tau_{s_1 q_1}, tau_{s_2 q_2}>_H = gcd(s_1, s_2)<tau_{(s_1/g)q_1}, tau_{(s_2/g)q_2}>_H, prime-power step obstruction min_{g in V_N^{pp}} ||1-g||_H^2 >= 1/92, and omega(k)-shell Euler-product Schur-complement variance reduction up to N = 512.
title: Bernoulli-2 Farey Large-Sieve Neutral Descent and Supercritical Truncated Divisor Covariance
